versioning: patch release: a planner policy fix (backfill reservations for several blocked jobs); no schema change, no new job input, no new side effect

database_schema.change: none; rollback leaves the schema at 10

node_config: config/zenobia-16core-node.json: the live 16-core node.json (0.8.0) plus scheduler.reservation_depth 8 (absent: 8; 1 = the EASY backfill of 0.8.0)
problem: 2026-11-06 ~02:00Z on live 0.8.0: head job 1402 (priority 10, 16 cores, 15G) held the only reservation 8.5 h ahead; five priority-5 4-core 30-min jobs waited 1.5 h+ while ~30 priority-0 one-core 2-h probes took every freed core (none delayed the head), so four cores were never free at once; worked around by hand with priority 11

policy.reservations: the first scheduler.reservation_depth blocked owner jobs in dispatch order; the first at its 0.8.0 shadow time, each later one at the earliest moment it fits for its whole limit beside the running jobs and the reservations ahead (resource-time profile: cores, requested and actual memory, GPU budget)
policy.backfill_test: a job that fits now starts only if every reserved job ahead of it can still start at its reserved time with the job running until its limit (reservations re-placed around it, in order); else 'backfill would delay job N'
policy.depth_1: exactly the 0.8.0 EASY planner (starts, cores, reservation, reasons)
policy.no_reservation: jobs refused as backfill, parked jobs, jobs held behind a paused ensemble, infeasible jobs

rejected_alternatives.independent_shadows: two reservations count the same cores (the second starts too early), and a job whose shadow precedes the head's but whose limit overlaps it holds free cores idle
rejected_alternatives.conservative_backfill: pins reservations to chosen cores and refuses backfill on other cores; depth 1 would no longer be 0.8.0

features: scheduler.reservation_depth (default 8, 1..64): backfill reservations for the first N blocked owner jobs
reservations placed in a resource-time profile after the ones ahead (no two count the same cores)
backfill test against every reservation ahead; refusals name the reservation they would delay
same-shape refusals answered once per pass (until the next start)
simq show: 'reserved to start by <UTC>' for every reserved job; 'head of the queue for N min' / 'reservation K of the queue for N min'

borrow.lend_reserved lends the cores of every reservation (borrowers stay invisible to owners and are preempted when the reserved owner starts); backfill_waiting_owners bound follows the reservation a refused owner would delay
GPU line: ready_except_gpu uses the same reservations (a GPU job that would delay one is not ready)
simq doctor 'Backfill' line; simq partitions --json reservation_depth
tools/bench-plan.py (planner cost per pass), tools/compare-easy.py (suite with depth 1 checked against the 0.8.0 planner)
upgrade.py 0.8.0 <-> 0.8.1 (no schema change; dry run previews the reservations for the live queue)
machine: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 (BIOS 2503): cores 0-15, SMT siblings 16-31, L3 CCD0 cores 0-7 / CCD1 cores 8-15, 96 MiB each, one NUMA node, 30 GB RAM
